NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以CUDA软件栈和全栈协同设计构建数据中心规模AI基础设施平台
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Building data-center-scale AI infrastructure platforms via CUDA software stack and extreme co-design
concrete_bets: Extreme co-design of chips, networking, systems, software, and algorithms

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以负责任AI贯穿技术栈，打造智能云与Copilot代理平台，赋能个人与组织生产力。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Make responsible AI available broadly across every layer of the tech stack, powering Copilot and agents on the intelligent cloud.
concrete_bets: Intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform with AI capabilities
AI-driven security, compliance, identity, and privacy products

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以Ontology为核心，将AIP生成式AI模型集成进Gotham和Foundry，把AI带入企业和政府的每个决策。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Embed generative AI via AIP into Gotham and Foundry, bringing AI to every enterprise and government decision.
concrete_bets: AIP platform integrating LLMs into Gotham and Foundry
Ontology as the semantic core connecting data and AI
Unified access to open-source, self-hosted, and commercial LLMs

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以Meta AI助手为核心，将自研AI嵌入全系应用、AI眼镜与下一代硬件，驱动内容排序与发现引擎。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Embed proprietary Meta AI across apps, AI glasses, and next-gen hardware, powering ranking and discovery.
concrete_bets: Meta AI assistant across apps, web, and AI glasses
Reality Labs AI and hardware R&D

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖LLM插件升级、调试工具、浏览器渲染技巧、代码审查观点、小游戏与文本检测器等面向个人开发者的生成式AI应用与工具。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers LLM plugin releases, debug tools, browser rendering tricks, code review commentary, mini-games, and text detection apps for individual developers.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 聚焦新一代前沿大模型与多模态开源模型发布，包括循环Transformer、Indic预训练、Beam、Granite、Muse、FLUX及端侧模型。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Focuses on new frontier and multimodal open models: looped transformers, Indic pretraining, Beam, Granite, Muse, FLUX, and on-device models.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 展示AI在银行客服、信贷分析、法律合同审查、安全运营与智能体平台中的规模化商业落地与营收表现。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Shows scaled enterprise deployments and revenue impact across banking, credit analysis, legal review, security ops, and agent platforms.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖Apple Silicon内核优化、LLM信念更新、自主湿实验室、地球空间智能体、技术文档审阅及科研创新等AI科学与智能体应用。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers Apple Silicon kernel optimization, LLM belief updates, autonomous wet labs, geospatial agents, document review, and research innovation.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及文本分类模型校准、AI文本水印检测、极端天气模拟以及智能体隐私安全和联邦数据可信学习等安全隐私议题。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Addresses text classification calibration, AI watermark detection, extreme weather simulation, agentic privacy/security, and private federated learning.
